name: repo-analyze
description: Repository intelligence engine. Converts any codebase (Go, Python, TS/JS, Rust, C/C++, Java, and more) into a durable, compressed knowledge graph stored in .claude/repo-knowledge/ — including an exact file:line symbol index, change-propagation chains, and invariants — so an AI can answer questions, assess impact, and plan precise edits without re-reading source.
